periodFactors._note: ASSUMPTION: hourly volume relative to the PM peak hour on arterials; typical urban weekday profile, to be calibrated.

kFactorNote: ASSUMPTION: peak-hour share of ADT for urban arterials (typically 0.08-0.10); not derived from local data.

classDefaultAdt._note: ASSUMPTION: per-class default two-way ADT when no count exists for the gate street (residential 800 ~ low-volume local street; uncalibrated).

streetCounts._note: DATA: Oakland PM peak-hour turning-movement counts at Telegraph Ave & Alcatraz Ave (Quality Counts; 2018-09-11, 2018-09-12, 2019-09-10, 2021-09-29), averaged. Leg volumes entering/leaving the intersection are used for gates lying on that leg's street in that compass direction from the count intersection (N/E/S/W). ASSUMPTION: the south Telegraph gate (Claremont) reuses the S-leg volume as a proxy.

adtOverrides.source: Caltrans AADT 2023 (SR-13 Claremont Ave, Berkeley PM 10.79, ahead AADT 23500; BACK 32500). Context: nearest published State count, located ~1 km east/south-east of the Claremont/College gate; applied with ASSUMPTION of 0.6 factor because the SR-13 count is at Ashby/Tunnel Rd, not Claremont Ave itself.

streetMatch._note: Lower-case substrings of OSM link names mapped to a count key.

local._note: ASSUMPTION: vehicle trip rates per resident worker / per job per weekday; ITE-like order of magnitude, uncalibrated.
local.vehicleModeShareNote: ASSUMPTION: drive-alone+carpool share for commutes (ACS-like; not derived here).

freewayNote: Links of these classes form the freeway. Gates on them are freeway gates: they only exchange trips with surface streets through the ramps found in the network (surface nodes touched by both freeway and surface links). Freeway mainline-to-mainline trips are not generated (they never touch surface streets).

ramps._note: Ramp demand. DATA: ramp ADT rows from Caltrans ramp-volume workbooks (raw.caltransRamps), matched to network ramps by street name (streetMatch) and type (OFF TO / ON FR); latest count year used, no growth applied (ASSUMPTION). Everything below is ASSUMPTION unless stated.
ramps.kFactorNote: ASSUMPTION: peak-hour share of ramp ADT, same urban range as the arterial K-factor; period volume factors (periodFactors) apply on top.
ramps.defaultAdtNote: ASSUMPTION: ADT of a ramp with no matching published count.
ramps.localShareNote: ASSUMPTION: share of ramp trips whose surface end is an in-area (LODES) node rather than a surface gate. These trips replace part of the block's external local trips.
ramps.maxShareOfGateNote: ASSUMPTION: ramp trips use at most this share of a surface gate's in/outflow target (surface totals stay consistent; the Furness step fills the rest).

destination._note: ASSUMPTION: gravity over surface gates and local nodes, attraction x direction plausibility. Plausibility = exp(-(dTheta/sigma)^2) floored, where dTheta is the angle between the bearing ramp->destination and the bearing ramp->study-area centre. No distance term. Street choice is left to the simulator.
